terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.introA: These Terms govern your use of The Global Altar Watch at
terms.introB: — the devotion slots, prayer rooms, community feed, messages, and groups. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to them.
terms.glance1.title: A reverent community
terms.glance1.text: TGAW is a Christian watch — devotion, prayer, and fellowship. We guard it with kindness and truth.
terms.glance2.title: Your content, your responsibility
terms.glance2.text: You keep ownership of what you share; you give us a license to show it in the community.
terms.glance3.title: Respect the watch
terms.glance3.text: No hate, harassment, spam, or impersonation. Leaders and moderators may hide or remove content.
terms.noticeTitle: Plain-language summary, not a substitute for reading.
terms.noticeBody: The cards above are a friendly overview — the numbered sections below are what you agree to. If you do not agree, please do not use TGAW.
terms.s1.title: 1. Eligibility & accounts
terms.s1.p1: You must be at least 13 years old to create an account (16 where local law requires). Provide accurate information and keep your password confidential. You are responsible for all activity under your account.
terms.s1.li1: One account per person; do not impersonate others.
terms.s1.li2a: Notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized use:
terms.s1.li3: We may require email verification before enabling community features.
terms.s2.title: 2. Community guidelines
terms.s2.p1: TGAW is a house of prayer for all nations. We ask every member to watch in love:
terms.s2.li1: Be respectful — no hate speech, harassment, or personal attacks. Disagreement without dishonor.
terms.s2.li2: No spam, unsolicited promotion, or repetitive posting.
terms.s2.li3: Prayer requests and testimonies are sacred — do not share another member's sensitive story outside the community without consent.
terms.s2.li4: Leaders, coordinators, and moderators may hide, limit, or remove content that breaches these guidelines, consistent with our moderation process.
terms.s3.title: 3. Your content & license
terms.s3.p1: You retain ownership of the text, images, tracts, prayers, and media you share. By posting, you grant TGAW a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to host, display, and distribute that content within the service (including to other members via feed, messages, and groups) for as long as it remains visible.
terms.s3.li1: You represent that you have the rights to share what you post and that it does not infringe others' rights.
terms.s3.li2: You can delete your posts/comments; deletion removes them from the feed, though others may have already seen or quoted them.
terms.s3.li3: Feedback and suggestions you send may be used without obligation.
terms.s4.title: 4. Slots, bookings & meetings
terms.s4.p1: Devotion slots (Bible, Prayer, Worship) are 1-hour commitments. One booking per slot per member; use consecutive slots if you desire a longer watch. Daily limits per type are set by the community (see Booking page).
terms.s4.li1: Cancel from the slot timeline if you cannot keep a time — it frees the slot for another member.
terms.s4.li2: Meeting links (Zoom/Teams) are provided per devotion type per day; treat them as community spaces.
terms.s4.li3: We may block or release slots for special gatherings; displaced bookings are restored when the block ends.
terms.s5.title: 5. Acceptable use
terms.s5.li1: Violate law, or upload unlawful, infringing, or harmful content.
terms.s5.li2: Attempt to access accounts, data, or systems without authorization (including scraping or reverse engineering beyond normal browser use).
terms.s5.li3: Interfere with the service (flooding bookings, spamming messages, evading bans).
terms.s5.li4: Use prayer or messaging features for harassment, solicitation, or non-consensual outreach.
terms.s5.p2: We may rate-limit, throttle, or restrict features to protect the community.
terms.s6.title: 6. Intellectual property
terms.s6.p1: The TGAW name, logo, and platform software are owned by TGAW or its licensors and are protected by copyright, trademark, and other laws. No license is granted except to use the service as intended.
terms.s6.p2a: If you believe content infringes your rights, contact
terms.s6.p2b: with the details (DMCA-style notice where applicable); we will act promptly.
terms.s7.title: 7. Disclaimers
terms.s7.p1: TGAW provides community and devotional tools, not professional pastoral, counseling, legal, or medical advice. Prayer, testimonies, and encouragement are spiritual support, not substitutes for professional care.
terms.s7.p2: The service is provided “as is” and “as available” without warranties of any kind, to the fullest extent allowed by law.
terms.s8.title: 8. Limitation of liability
terms.s8.p1: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, TGAW and its leaders, contributors, and hosts are not liable for indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the service, even if advised of the possibility.
terms.s8.p2: Where liability cannot be excluded, it is limited to the greater of (a) the amount you paid to TGAW in the 6 months before the claim (currently most use is free) or (b) €/US$100.
terms.s8.p3: Nothing in these Terms limits liability for fraud, willful misconduct, or where the law does not permit limitation.
terms.s9.title: 9. Suspension & termination
terms.s9.p1: We may suspend or terminate accounts or remove content that breaches these Terms, harms the community, or creates risk — including temporary bans, permanent bans, and content hiding by leaders/superadmins as described in the app.
terms.s9.li1: You can delete your account in Settings at any time; some content may remain if already shared with others or retained for legal/ abuse-prevention reasons.
terms.s9.li2a: Appeal a moderation action by emailing
terms.s10.title: 10. Governing law & disputes
terms.s10.p1: These Terms are governed by the laws specified at deployment time (and, where you are a consumer, the mandatory protections of your home jurisdiction still apply). We hope to resolve concerns informally — please contact us first. Formal disputes may be brought in the competent courts of the governing jurisdiction, or in your local courts where the law gives you that right.
terms.s10.p2: For EU consumers, information on alternative dispute resolution is available via the EU ODR platform.
terms.s11.title: 11. Changes to these Terms
terms.s11.p1: We may update these Terms as the community and laws evolve. Material changes will be posted here with a new effective date; continued use after the date means you accept the updated Terms. If changes are significant, we will also notify signed-in members in-app.
terms.contact.title: Contact
terms.contact.desc: Questions about these Terms, or need an appeal?
terms.contact.subject: — subject “Terms”.
terms.footerNote: These Terms do not create pastoral or fiduciary duties.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: TGAW is built for the global watch — from the EU to California to Brazil and beyond. This policy explains what we collect, why we collect it, and the rights you have in your region. We keep it plain, and the same protections travel with you.
privacy.cookieNote: Manage non-essential cookies anytime: Avatar → Cookie Preferences, or below.
privacy.what.title: What we collect
privacy.what.body: Account details you give us, content you create (posts, bookings, messages), and technical signals (IP country, device, consent). No sensitive categories unless you share them.
privacy.why.title: Why & legal basis
privacy.why.bodyA: To run the community you joined (contract), keep it safe (legitimate interest), and only set analytics/marketing when you
privacy.controls.title: Your controls
privacy.controls.bodyA: View, correct, delete, or export your data. In the US:
privacy.controls.bodyB: . Everywhere: withdraw consent in one tap.

privacy.s1.p1b: operates the community platform for devotion, prayer, Bible reading, and fellowship at
privacy.s1.p1c: . We are the controller for personal data processed on the site.
privacy.s1.li2: DPO / privacy contact: same address — subject “Privacy Request”.
privacy.s1.li3: EU representative (where applicable) and US contact details are provided on request.
privacy.s2.title: 2. Personal data we collect
privacy.r1.examples: Name, email, password hash, avatar, role, timezone, country, age range
privacy.r1.purpose: Create & secure your account; personalize bookings
privacy.r1.retention: While account active + 30 days after deletion request
privacy.r2.examples: Posts, comments, likes, bookings, messages, group membership, presence heartbeat
privacy.r2.purpose: Deliver community, slots, chat and feed
privacy.r2.retention: Until you delete or account closure
privacy.r3.examples: IP country, device, tgaw_consent, session_token, analytics events (if consented)
privacy.r3.retention: tgaw_consent 12 months; session 30 days; analytics 14 months
privacy.r4.examples: Email/push preferences, notification logs, support messages
privacy.r4.purpose: Send devotion reminders & updates per your preferences
privacy.childrenNote: We do not intentionally collect data from children under 13, and do not process special categories (health, political, religious beliefs) except where you voluntarily share a testimony or prayer request — processed only for the feature you used.
privacy.s3.title: 3. Purposes & legal bases (GDPR Art. 6)
privacy.contract.title: Contract
privacy.contract.desc: To deliver what you signed up for.
privacy.contract.body: Creating your account, saving bookings, delivering messages, posts, and presence — without this, the watch cannot function.
privacy.interest.title: Legitimate interest
privacy.interest.body: Fraud prevention, rate limiting, crash logs, and strictly necessary cookies. We balance this against your rights and keep it minimal.
privacy.consent.title: Consent
privacy.consent.bodyA: Non-essential cookies, email/push notifications, and any analytics/marketing. Withdraw in
privacy.legal.title: Legal obligation
privacy.legal.body: Responding to lawful requests, tax record-keeping, or enforcing our Terms. We only share what is required.
privacy.s4.title: 4. Cookies, Consent Mode & signals
privacy.s4.p1b: banner: EU/EEA, UK, Brazil, Canada, Japan, Korea, South Africa and similar regions see strict opt-in (non-essential cookies off until you consent); US states see opt-out with
privacy.s4.p1c: ; elsewhere we show notice-only. See the full
privacy.s4.p1d: for the cookie table and durations.

privacy.s4.li3b: (12 months, v1) and honors expiry/version bumps.
privacy.s5.title: 5. Sharing & processors
privacy.s5.p1: We only share with trusted processors who make TGAW work:
privacy.s5.li2b: — Better Auth, SMTP provider (to verify email, reset passwords).
privacy.s5.li4b: — Google Analytics 4 via Consent Mode; never loaded before consent in strict regions.
privacy.s5.p2: We do not sell your personal information. US “sharing” for cross-context ads only occurs if you allow Marketing — turn it off to opt out.
privacy.s6.title: 6. Retention
privacy.s6.li1: Account & content: while your account is active; deleted quickly after you delete your account or content (residual backups expire within 30–60 days).
privacy.s6.li2: Logs & heartbeat presence: short-lived (minutes to days); presence rows auto-expire via TTL.
privacy.s6.li3: Cookie consent: 12 months or until a version bump.
privacy.s6.li4: Where the law requires longer (e.g., tax, abuse logs), we keep the minimum required and no more.
privacy.s7.title: 7. International transfers
privacy.s7.p1a: Our infrastructure may process data in the US and EU. For transfers from the EEA/UK/Switzerland we rely on adequacy decisions where available, otherwise
privacy.s7.p1b: and supplementary measures. Brazil (LGPD), South Africa (POPIA), and others are handled on the same basis.
privacy.s8.title: 8. Security
privacy.s8.p1: We protect data with hashed passwords, scoped sessions, RBAC (member → superadmin), TLS, and least-privilege access. No system is 100% secure — use a strong, unique password and enable 2FA in Settings when available.
privacy.s9.title: 9. Your rights
privacy.s9.introA: Your region shapes your rights — we honor the strongest among them. To exercise any right, email
privacy.s9.introB: or use in-app Settings where available.
privacy.rights.r1.how: Request a copy of your personal information
privacy.deletion.title: Deletion
privacy.deletion.body: Delete your account in Settings. We will remove posts, bookings, and profile promptly; backups age out within 60 days. We keep only what the law requires.
privacy.donotsell.title: Do Not Sell / GPC
privacy.donotsell.bodyB: , or turn on GPC in your browser. No discrimination for exercising rights.
privacy.s10.title: 10. Changes & contact
privacy.s10.p1: We will update this policy when our practices or applicable laws change. Material changes bump tgaw_consent version and re-show the banner; the “Updated” badge at the top will change.
privacy.s10.p3: Supervisory authority (EEA/UK) and state AG (US) contact details available on request. We respond to verifiable requests within 30 days (EU) / 45 days (US), with a single 45-day extension where allowed.
privacy.footerNote: GDPR · CCPA/CPRA · LGPD · POPIA · APPI · PIPA compliant · Consent Mode v2 & GPC supported · This is not legal advice.
